description: Search Georgian law articles by words. Search in Georgian, with the terms the law itself uses; if the results are off the point, search again with the law's own word and ignore also_searched terms that do not fit. Returns matching articles with an exact text snippet, code, article number, official matsne.gov.ge link and version date. found=false means nothing matched: say so, never guess. კანონის მუხლების ძიება სიტყვებით: ზუსტი ამონარიდი, კოდექსი, მუხლის ნომერი, ოფიციალური ბმული და თარიღი.

code.description: Optional: limit to one code (id or name).
code.title: Code

query.description: What to look for, best in Georgian legal terms, e.g. 'სააპელაციო საჩივრის ვადა'.
query.title: Query

name: search_law

article_number.description: As printed in the law, e.g. 'მუხლი 369'.
article_number.title: Article Number

id.description: Stable id, usable with fetch: article:<code>:<number>.
id.title: Id

in_force_since.description: Date this article's current wording took effect, if known.
in_force_since.title: In Force Since

notice.default: ეს არის კანონის ტექსტი და წყარო, არა იურიდიული კონსულტაცია. ოფიციალური ტექსტი: matsne.gov.ge. This is law text and its source, not legal advice. The official text is on matsne.gov.ge; for important decisions consult a lawyer.
notice.title: Notice

snippet.description: Exact text copied from the stored article (may be an excerpt).
snippet.title: Snippet

source_url.description: Official matsne.gov.ge link for this text.
source_url.title: Source Url

version_date.description: Date of the consolidated version this text comes from.
version_date.title: Version Date

version_note.description: Present when a version date is unknown or text may be incomplete.
version_note.title: Version Note

also_searched.description: The law's own terms the search added for everyday words in the query.
also_searched.title: Also Searched

data_current_as_of.description: Date (ISO) the stored law texts were last confirmed against matsne.gov.ge. Tell the person this date.
data_current_as_of.title: Data Current As Of

freshness_warning.description: Set when that check is overdue or its date is unknown; pass the warning on with the answer.
freshness_warning.title: Freshness Warning
